item.title: Morocco Rewrites Drug Pricing Rules — and Clears Land for High-Speed Rail and OCP's New Phosphate Line
item.description: Morocco rewrites its drug-pricing formula, clears land for high-speed rail and OCP’s phosphate corridor, pipes water to Taounate, launches a Youth Pass, and formalizes tribal land boundaries — all from this week’s Official Gazette.

item.title: Morocco's Own Watchdog Says Street Violence Is Up 29% — And Nobody's Punished for It
item.description: This issue’s real news: a hard-numbers state report on rising public disorder, more land seized for the Marrakech high-speed rail extension, RAM’s new pilot-and-mechanic training arm, and extended tariff breaks on wheat and meat.
